brand_summary: Sarvam AI has rapidly expanded its sovereign AI footprint by launching its flagship 30B and 105B LLMs, open-sourcing models, releasing the Saaras V4 speech engine across 22 Indian languages, and securing enterprise rollouts with major industry leaders like IndiGo, Maruti Suzuki, and IDFC FIRST Bank. Moving forward, the company is signalling ambitious plans to train a trillion-parameter model, deploy India-hosted inference infrastructure, grant creators early model access, and expand enterprise scaling via its Circle Programme.
